gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari is a modern plain sans with a compact skyline, where capitals melt into the lowercase around it. Under Eater's dark, wide-spaced headings, it keeps paragraphs easy going.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Noto Sans Duployan has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and oversized counters that feel contemporary and clean. Beneath Eater's dark, spiky heading, Noto Sans Duployan lets a long stretch of text flow without any snagging.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan is large in the lowercase, with terminals that never pinch shut. Its openness makes a quiet foil for Eater, whose dark, gently modulated strokes and wide gaps carry all the aggression.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open and its ascenders hugging the x-height, so it feels clean and modern. And Eater's strokes narrow gradually toward their ends, which gives the pair a dark headline with a plainly spoken partner.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between its letters. Noto Sans Ethiopic is a plain sans with a tall, sturdy lowercase and hanging c terminals, so give it a comfortable size and let it hold the page.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Eater brings a moderate thick-thin modulation and short ascenders, which gives its dark mood some restraint. It earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans Georgian stays modern and clean.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Open, round and sturdy in the lowercase, this plain sans reads clearly even when small. Noto Sans Glagolitic handles the quiet work while Eater, tapered like a sharpened carpenter's pencil line, supplies the dark attitude.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Aggressive is Eater's whole temperament, with widely spaced letters and modest contrast that shows up on a close look. But Noto Sans Gothic, with counters like drilled glass beads, does the modern, professional reading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Eater is dark and wide-spaced, with short ascenders. It is built for attention-grabbing display, whereas Noto Sans Grantha, a plain sans with tall little letters that never snag on a closed bowl, is made for steady reading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Stems only a little heavier than their hairlines give Eater a dark, wide-spaced character. And Noto Sans Gujarati, clean and modern with large open counters, makes that menace easy to live beside.
